<thought>
Based on the carbon shift ranges:
- Aromatic C-H (Ar-H): 115-130 ppm
- Aromatic C (Ar-C): 130-150 ppm
- Phenols (C1): 150-160 ppm

Looking at my 13C NMR data:
- 170.20 ppm - This is in the carboxylic acid/ester region (160-180 ppm), NOT aromatic
- 169.60 ppm - This is also in the carboxylic acid/ester region, NOT aromatic
- 151.28 ppm - This is in the phenolic carbon range (150-160 ppm), which is AROMATIC
- 134.64 ppm - This is in the aromatic C range (130-150 ppm), AROMATIC
- 132.51 ppm - This is in the aromatic C range (130-150 ppm), AROMATIC
- 124.01 ppm - This is in the aromatic C-H range (115-130 ppm), AROMATIC
- 123.09 ppm - This is in the aromatic C-H range (115-130 ppm), AROMATIC
- 122.26 ppm - This is in the aromatic C-H range (115-130 ppm), AROMATIC
- 20.67 ppm - This is in the aliphatic CH3 range (10-30 ppm), NOT aromatic

Counting the aromatic carbons:
151.28, 134.64, 132.51, 124.01, 123.09, 122.26

That's 6 aromatic carbons in total.
</thought>
<final_answer>6</final_answer>
